answer: The proof is verified where it was made, not where the applicant says it was made. Take the dune away and the name goes; take the karst away and the stake goes; take the walnut away and the past goes. The threshold charges in days as well as coins: 11 days to cure a proof, and a farm cannot cure 204 proofs any faster. A single honest proof outweighs a warehouse of masks, and Agate polisher polished agate warrant faceted in the lapidary shop is that proof, written as each polished agate is a year of stone logs in the lapidary ledger.
